title: Accessibility Features
excerpt: Learn about Kahana Browser's accessibility features and how to use them.
content:
Accessibility Features

Kahana Browser is designed to be accessible to all users. Here are the key accessibility features:

Screen Reader Support

Full compatibility with popular screen readers including:

  • NVDA
  • JAWS
  • VoiceOver

Keyboard Navigation

Comprehensive keyboard shortcuts for all features:

  • Tab navigation
  • Shortcut keys
  • Customizable key bindings

Visual Adjustments

Customize your visual experience:

  • High contrast mode
  • Text size adjustment
  • Color filters
